BENIGN.description: Normal network activity that has not been classified as malicious.

ATTACK.description: Network activity classified as suspicious by the intrusion detection model.
ATTACK.recommended_action: Investigate the flow and review related network activity.

DDoS.description: Distributed Denial of Service activity attempts to overwhelm a service or network resource.
DDoS.recommended_action: Investigate traffic volume, source distribution, and affected services.

Port Scan.description: A port scanning activity attempts to discover accessible network services.
Port Scan.recommended_action: Review destination ports, source host activity, and connection patterns.

Brute Force.description: Repeated authentication attempts may indicate an attempt to guess credentials.
Brute Force.recommended_action: Review authentication logs and source addresses.
